name: revAcc_nil
prelude:
def myRev : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => myRev xs ++ [x]

def revAcc : List α → List α → List α
  | [], acc => acc
  | x :: xs, acc => revAcc xs (x :: acc)
statement: theorem revAcc_nil (xs : List α) : revAcc xs [] = myRev xs
proofs:
have invariant (zs acc : List α) : revAcc zs acc = myRev zs ++ acc := by
    induction zs generalizing acc with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons z zs ih => simp [revAcc, myRev, ih, List.append_assoc]
  simpa using invariant xs []
  have shift (zs as bs : List α) : revAcc zs (as ++ bs) = revAcc zs as ++ bs := by
    induction zs generalizing as with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons z zs ih => simpa [revAcc] using ih (z :: as)
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have h := shift xs [] [x]
    simpa [revAcc, myRev, ih] using h
strategies: Generalize to arbitrary accumulator suffixes and prove the full invariant.
Prove suffix-equivariance of revAcc, then induct with the accumulator fixed at nil.
